import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_simultaneous_equalizer_closed
  {α : Type} [MetricSpace α]
  (n : ℕ) (f g : Fin n → α → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i))
  (z : Set α) (hz : z = {x | ∀ i, f i x = g i x}) : IsClosed z := by
  rw [hz]
  have : {x : α | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} = ⋂ i : Fin n, {x : α | f i x = g i x} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact isClosed_iInter (fun i => isClosed_eq (hf i) (hg i))
